cnst2kk.construction: Time varying constant term. See text.

COG.name: COG
COG.description: Purchases of consumption and investment goods, g, B2017$.

COS.name: COS
COS.description: Purchases of consumption and investment goods, s, B2017$.

CTB.name: CTB

CTF1.name: CTF1

CTGMB.name: CTGMB

GSNN.name: GSNN
GSNN.description: Gross saving of nonfinancial noncorporate business (the 'NN' flow-of-funds sub-sector of the firm sector), in billions of current dollars; identity GSNN = GDP deflator times real GSNNQ.

GSNNQ.description: Real (inflation-adjusted) gross saving of nonfinancial noncorporate business (the 'NN' flow-of-funds sub-sector), in chained 2017 dollars; equals nominal GSNN divided by the GDP deflator.

HG.name: HG

HM.name: HM

HO.name: HO
HO.description: Average number of overtime hours paid per job, f, hours per quarter.

HS.name: HS
HS.description: Average number of hours paid per job, s, hours per quarter.

IBTG.name: IBTG
IBTG.description: Indirect business taxes collected by the federal government (sales/excise-type taxes on business), in billions of current dollars.

IKB.name: IKB
IKB.description: Real nonresidential fixed investment of the financial business sector (b), chained 2017$. (Restore 'nonresidential'.)

INS.name: INS
INS.description: Insurance and pension reserves to h from g, B$.

KD.name: KD
KD.construction: Def., Eq. 58. Base Period=1952.1, Value=228.1, Dep. Rate=DELD

KH.name: KH

KK.name: KK

KKM.name: KKM
KKM.description: Amount of capital required to produce Y, B2017$.

L3.name: L3
L3.description: Labor force of all others, 16+, millions.

LAM.name: LAM

LM.name: LM
LM.description: Number of moonlighters: the gap between total jobs (establishment/payroll data) and total people employed (household survey), reflecting multiple-jobholders, in millions (defined in equation 8).

M1.name: M1
M1.description: Money supply, end of quarter, B$.

MB.name: MB

MDIF.name: MDIF
MDIF.description: Net increase in demand deposits and currency of banks in U.S. possessions plus change in demand deposits and currency of private nonbank financial institutions plus change in demand deposits and currency of federally sponsored credit agencies and mortgage pools minus mail float, U.S. government, B$.

MF.name: MF
MF.description: Demand deposits and currency, f, B$.
MF.construction: Sum of CDDCF+MAILFLT1+MAILFLT2+CDDCN+MAILFLT3, Base Period=1971.4, Value=84.075

MG.name: MG
MG.description: Demand deposits and currency, g, B$.
MG.construction: Sum of CDDCUS+CDDCCA-NIDDLRMA-NIDDLGMA-NIDDLCMA, Base Period=1971.4, Value=10.526

MGQ.name: MGQ
MGQ.description: Demand deposits and currency, g, B2017$.

MH.name: MH
MH.description: Demand deposits and currency, h, B$.
MH.construction: Sum of CDDCH1. Base Period=1971.4, Value=132.050

MHQ.name: MHQ
MHQ.description: Demand deposits and currency, h, B2017$.

MRQ.name: MRQ
MRQ.description: Demand deposits and currency, r, B2017$.

MS.name: MS

MSQ.name: MSQ
MSQ.description: Demand deposits and currency, s, B2017$.

MUH.name: MUH
MUH.description: Amount of output capable of being produced per unit of capital.

NICD.name: NICD

NNF.name: NNF
NNF.description: Net acquisition of nonproduced nonfinancial assets, f, B$.

NNG.name: NNG
NNG.description: Net acquisition of nonproduced nonfinancial assets, g, B$.

NNH.name: NNH
NNH.description: Net acquisition of nonproduced nonfinancial assets, h, B$.

NNR.name: NNR
NNR.description: Net acquisition of nonproduced nonfinancial assets, r, B$.

NNS.name: NNS
NNS.description: Net acquisition of nonproduced nonfinancial assets, s, B$.

PCGDPD.name: PCGDPD
PCGDPD.description: Percentage change in GDPD, annual rate, percentage points.

PCGDPR.name: PCGDPR
PCGDPR.description: Percentage change in GDPR, annual rate, percentage points.

PCM1.name: PCM1
PCM1.description: Percentage change in M1, annual rate, percentage points.

POP3.name: POP3
POP3.description: Noninstitutional population of all others, 16+, millions.

PROD.description: Output per paid for worker hour ("productivity").

PS13.name: PS13
PS13.description: Ratio of gross product of g and s to total employee hours of g and s.

PUS.name: PUS
PUS.description: Purchases of goods and services, s, B$.

PX.name: PX

Q.name: Q

QQ.name: QQ
QQ.description: Gold and foreign exchange, g, B2017$.

RMA.name: RMA
RMA.description: After tax mortgage rate, percentage points.

RS.name: RS

RSA.name: RSA
RSA.description: After tax bill rate, percentage points.

SGP.name: SGP
SGP.description: NIPA surplus (+) or deficit (-), g, B$.

SHRPIE.name: SHRPIE
SHRPIE.description: Ratio of after tax profits to the wage bill net of employer social security taxes.

SIFG.name: SIFG
SIFG.description: Employer social insurance (payroll) contributions paid by firms to the federal government, in billions of dollars (defined by Eq. 54).
SIFG.short_name: Employer Social Insurance, Firm To Federal

SIFS.name: SIFS
SIFS.description: Employer social insurance (payroll) contributions paid by firms to state and local governments, in billions of dollars (exogenous).
SIFS.short_name: Employer Social Insurance, Firm To State

SSP.name: SSP
SSP.description: NIPA surplus (+) or deficit (-), s, B$.

STATP.name: STATP
STATP.description: Statistical discrepancy relating to the use of chain type prices in indices, B2017$.

SUBS.name: SUBS
SUBS.description: Subsidies less current surplus of government enterprises, s, B$.

TBL2.name: TBL2

TBG.name: TBG

TBG.short_name: Financial Sector Profit Taxes To Federal

TBGQ.name: TBGQ
TBGQ.description: Corporate profit taxes, b to g, B2017$.

TBS.name: TBS

TBS.short_name: Financial Sector Profit Taxes To State Local

TCG.description: Corporate profit tax receipts, g, B$.

TCS.description: Corporate profit tax receipts, s, B$.

TF1.description: Corporate profit tax payments, F1, B$.

TFG.description: Corporate profit taxes, f to g, B$.

THETA3.description: Ratio of NICD to PCD . CD.

THG.description: Personal income taxes, h to g, B$.

THS.name: THS
THS.description: Personal income taxes, h to s, B$.

TRFG.name: TRFG
TRFG.description: Transfer payments, f to g, B$.

TRFR.description: Transfer payments, f to r, B$.

TRFS.description: Transfer payments, f to s, B$.

TRGH.description: Transfer payments (net), g to h, B$.

TRGHQ.name: TRGHQ
TRGHQ.description: Transfer payments (net), g to h, B2017$.

TRGR.name: TRGR
TRGR.description: Transfer payments (net), g to r, B$.

TRGS.name: TRGS
TRGS.description: Transfer payments, g to s, B$.

TRGSQ.name: TRGSQ
TRGSQ.description: Transfer payments, g to s, B2017$.
TRGSQ.short_name: Real Fed Transfers To State Local

TRHR.name: TRHR
TRHR.description: Transfer payments, h to r, B$.

TRRS.name: TRRS
TRRS.description: Transfer payments, r to s, B$.

WA.name: WA
WA.description: After tax wage rate. (Includes supplements to wages and salaries except employer contributions for social insurance.)

WF.name: WF
WF.description: Average hourly earnings excluding overtime of workers in f. (Includes supplements to wages and salaries except employer contributions for social insurance.)

WG.name: WG
WG.description: Average hourly earnings of civilian workers in g. (Includes supplements to wages and salaries including employer contributions for social insurance.)

WH.name: WH
WH.description: Average hourly earnings excluding overtime of all workers. (Includes supplements to wages and salaries except employer contributions for social insurance.)

WM.name: WM
WM.description: Average hourly earnings of military workers. (Includes supplements to wages and salaries including employer contributions for social insurance.)

WR.name: WR
WR.description: Real wage rate of workers in f. (Includes supplements to wages and salaries except employer contributions for social insurance.)

WS.name: WS
WS.description: Average hourly earnings of workers in s. (Includes supplements to wages and salaries including employer contributions for social insurance.)

YS.name: YS
YS.construction: Computed from peak to peak interpolation of log Y. Peak quarters are 1953.2, 1966.1, 1973.2, 1999.4, 2006.4, and 2023.4.

CTH.name: CTH
CTH.description: Net capital transfers paid by households, in billions of current dollars.

CTNN.name: CTNN
CTNN.description: Net capital transfers paid by noncorporate (unincorporated) business, in billions of current dollars.

CTR.name: CTR
CTR.description: Net capital transfers paid by the foreign (rest-of-world) sector, in billions of current dollars.

CTS.name: CTS
CTS.description: Net capital transfers paid by state and local governments, in billions of current dollars.
CTS.short_name: State and Local Capital Transfers Paid

CUR.name: CUR
CUR.description: Currency held by the public outside of banks (the currency component of money), in billions of current dollars.
CUR.construction: Sum of NILCMA. Base Period=1971.4, Value=53.521

D1G.name: D1G
D1G.description: The federal personal income tax-rate parameter, i.e. the household average personal income tax rate at the federal level.

D1S.name: D1S
D1S.description: The state and local personal income tax-rate parameter, i.e. the household average personal income tax rate at the state and local level.
D1S.short_name: State and Local Personal Income Tax Rate

D2G.name: D2G
D2G.description: Federal government corporate profit (income) tax rate applied to firm taxable profits; defined by the identity TFG = D2G(PIEF - TFS).

D2S.name: D2S
D2S.description: State and local government corporate profit (income) tax rate applied to firm taxable profits; defined by the identity TFS = D2S*PIEF.

D4G.name: D4G
D4G.description: Federal employee social-security (social-insurance) contribution rate applied to the firm wage bill; defined by the identity SIHG = D4G[WF*JF(HN + 1.5HO)].

D5G.name: D5G
D5G.description: Federal employer social-security (social-insurance) contribution rate applied to the firm wage bill; defined by the identity SIFG = D5G[WF*JF(HN + 1.5HO)].

D6G.name: D6G
D6G.description: Federal-government (g) capital-consumption-rate parameter used in equation 67 to compute CCF1 from a four-quarter average of nominal firm fixed investment.

DELD.name: DELD
DELD.description: Quarterly physical depreciation rate of the stock of consumer durable goods, used in the durables stock identity KD = (1 - DELD)KD-1 + CD (Eq. 58).

DELH.name: DELH
DELH.description: Quarterly physical depreciation rate of the stock of housing, used in the housing stock identity KH = (1 - DELH)KH-1 + IHH (Eq. 59).

DELK.name: DELK
DELK.description: Quarterly physical depreciation rate of the firm business capital stock, used in the capital identity IKF = KK - (1-DELK)*KK(-1). (First pass had the sign wrong.)

DF.name: DF
DF.description: Net dividends paid by the firm (business) sector, in billions of nominal dollars.

DG.name: DG
DG.description: Net dividends paid by the federal government sector, in billions of nominal dollars (exogenous).

DISB.name: DISB
DISB.description: Statistical discrepancy term reconciling the income/flow (NIPA) and asset/stock (flow-of-funds) accounts for the financial (bank) sector, in billions of nominal dollars.

DISF.name: DISF
DISF.description: Statistical discrepancy term reconciling the income/flow (NIPA) and asset/stock (flow-of-funds) accounts for the firm (business) sector, in billions of nominal dollars.

DISG.name: DISG
DISG.description: Statistical discrepancy term reconciling the income/flow (NIPA) and asset/stock (flow-of-funds) accounts for the federal government sector, in billions of nominal dollars.

DISH.name: DISH
DISH.description: Statistical discrepancy term reconciling the income/flow (NIPA) and asset/stock (flow-of-funds) accounts for the household sector, in billions of nominal dollars.

DISR.name: DISR
DISR.description: Statistical discrepancy term reconciling the income/flow (NIPA) and asset/stock (flow-of-funds) accounts for the foreign (rest-of-world) sector, in billions of nominal dollars.

DISS.name: DISS
DISS.description: Statistical discrepancy term reconciling the income/flow (NIPA) and asset/stock (flow-of-funds) accounts for the state and local government sector, in billions of nominal dollars.

DR.name: DR
DR.description: Net dividends paid by the foreign (rest-of-world) sector, in billions of nominal dollars.

DRQ.name: DRQ
DRQ.description: Net dividends paid by the foreign (rest-of-world) sector in real (inflation-adjusted) terms, in billions of 2017 dollars.

DS.name: DS
DS.description: Net dividends paid by the state and local government sector, in billions of nominal dollars (exogenous).
DS.short_name: State & Local Gov Net Dividends Paid

EX.name: EX
EX.description: Exports of goods and services in real (inflation-adjusted) terms, in billions of 2017 dollars (exogenous).

EXPG.name: EXPG
EXPG.description: Net total expenditures of the federal government (purchases, transfers, interest, subsidies, and unemployment benefits, net of investment), in billions of nominal dollars.

EXPS.name: EXPS
EXPS.description: Net total expenditures of the state and local government (purchases, transfers, interest, and subsidies, net of investment), in billions of nominal dollars.

FA.name: FA
FA.description: Gross product of the farm sector in real (inflation-adjusted) terms, in billions of 2017 dollars (exogenous).

INTG.name: INTG
INTG.description: Net interest payments by the federal government, in billions of current dollars (defined in equation 29).

INTGR.name: INTGR
INTGR.description: Net interest payments from the federal government to the rest of the world (foreign sector), in billions of current dollars (defined in equation 56).

INTS.name: INTS
INTS.description: Net interest payments by the state and local government sector, in billions of current dollars.

INTZ.name: INTZ
INTZ.description: Net interest payments of the model's 'other' sector, B$ (A.7: PII-IPP-INTF1-(PAYINTG-RECINTG)+INTGR-(PAYINTS-RECINTS)); first-pass formula was incomplete.

INTZQ.name: INTZQ
INTZQ.description: Net interest payments of the residual ('other') sector in constant (real) dollars, computed as nominal other-sector interest deflated by the GDP deflator.

ISZ.name: ISZ
ISZ.description: Gross investment by the state and local government sector, in billions of current dollars (defined in equation 159).

ISZQ.name: ISZQ
ISZQ.description: Gross investment by the state and local government sector in constant (real) dollars, computed as nominal state/local gross investment deflated by the GDP deflator.

IVA.name: IVA
IVA.description: Inventory valuation adjustment (accounting correction removing capital-gain/loss on inventories from profits), in billions of current dollars.

IVF.name: IVF
IVF.description: Real (constant-dollar) inventory investment by the firm sector (the change in business inventories), in billions of constant dollars (defined in equation 117).

JF.name: JF
JF.description: Number of jobs in the firm sector.

JG.name: JG
JG.description: Number of civilian jobs in the federal government, in millions.

JHMIN.name: JHMIN
JHMIN.description: Number of worker hours required to produce the level of output Y (given technology), in millions (defined in equation 94).

JM.name: JM
JM.description: Number of military jobs in the federal government, in millions.

JS.name: JS
JS.description: Number of jobs in the state and local government sector, in millions.

KKMIN.name: KKMIN
KKMIN.description: Amount of physical capital required to produce the level of output Y (the minimum/needed capital stock), in billions of constant dollars (defined in equation 93).

PD.name: PD
PD.description: Price deflator (index) for domestic sales, i.e. total sales minus exports plus imports (X - EX + IM); defined by Eq. 33.

PEX.name: PEX
PEX.description: Price deflator (index) for exports, defined as nominal exports divided by real exports (EXZ/EX).

PF.name: PF
PF.description: Price deflator for nonfarm sales; the price-equation variable in Eq. 10. (Drop the extra 'firm-sector/core price level' wording beyond FAIR.)

PFA.name: PFA
PFA.description: Price deflator (index) for farm sales, defined as nominal farm sales divided by real farm sales (FAZ/FA).

PG.name: PG
PG.description: Price deflator (index) for federal government purchases of goods (COG), defined as net nominal federal purchases over net real federal purchases ((PURGZ-PROGZ)/(PURG-PROG)).

PH.name: PH
PH.description: Price deflator for household purchases of services, nondurables, durables and residential investment (CS+CN+CD+IHH), inclusive of indirect business taxes (Eq. 34). (Includes SERVICES — 'goods purchases' too narrow.)

PIEB.name: PIEB
PIEB.description: Before-tax profits of the financial (bank) sector (b), in billions of current dollars (B$); defined in the newer FAIR appendix Eq. 134 as PIEB = GSB + DB + TBG + TBS + CTGB.

PIEFRET.name: PIEFRET
PIEFRET.description: Foreign earnings of the firm (business) sector retained abroad, in billions of current (nominal) dollars; defined by Eq. 132.

PIH.name: PIH
PIH.description: Price deflator (index) for residential investment, defined as nominal residential investment divided by real residential investment (IHZ/IH).

PIK.name: PIK
PIK.description: Price deflator for nonresidential fixed investment, IKZ/IK (A.7).

PIM.name: PIM
PIM.description: Price deflator (index) for imports, defined as nominal imports divided by real imports (IMZ/IM); treated as exogenous.

PIV.name: PIV
PIV.description: Adjusted price deflator (index) for inventory investment, defined as nominal over real inventory investment (IVZ/IV) with quarter-specific adjustments; defined by Eq. 42.

PKH.name: PKH
PKH.description: Market price per unit of the household housing stock, REALEST/KH (A.7); refers to the housing stock, not the stock market.

PSI1.name: PSI1
PSI1.description: Exogenous price ratio of the exports deflator (PEX) to the total-sales deflator (PX), used to determine PEX in Eq. 32.

PSI2.name: PSI2
PSI2.description: Exogenous deflator-ratio parameter that scales the domestic price level (PD, gross of indirect-tax dummies) to produce the price deflator for consumer services (PCS); equation 35.

PSI3.name: PSI3
PSI3.description: Exogenous deflator-ratio parameter that scales the domestic price level (PD, gross of indirect-tax dummies) to produce the price deflator for consumer nondurables (PCN); equation 36.

PSI4.name: PSI4
PSI4.description: Exogenous deflator-ratio parameter that scales the domestic price level (PD, gross of indirect-tax dummies) to produce the price deflator for consumer durables (PCD); equation 37.

PSI5.name: PSI5
PSI5.description: Exogenous deflator-ratio parameter that scales the domestic price level (PD) to produce the price deflator for residential (housing) investment (PIH); equation 38.

PSI6.name: PSI6
PSI6.description: Exogenous ratio of PIK to PD that scales the domestic price level into the nonresidential fixed-investment deflator.

PSI7.name: PSI7
PSI7.description: Exogenous deflator-ratio parameter that scales the domestic price level (PD) to produce the price deflator for federal government purchases of goods (PG, deflator for COG); equation 40.

PSI8.name: PSI8
PSI8.description: Exogenous deflator-ratio parameter that scales the domestic price level (PD) to produce the price deflator for state-and-local government purchases of goods (PS, deflator for COS); equation 41.

PSI9.name: PSI9
PSI9.description: Exogenous deflator-ratio parameter that scales the domestic price level (PD) to produce the price deflator for inventory investment (PIV); equation 42.

PSI10.name: PSI10
PSI10.description: Exogenous ratio of the average federal government wage rate (WG) to the firm-sector wage rate (WF), used to determine WG in Eq. 44.

PSI11.name: PSI11
PSI11.description: Exogenous ratio of the average military wage rate (WM) to the firm-sector wage rate (WF), used to determine WM in Eq. 45.

PSI12.name: PSI12
PSI12.description: Exogenous ratio of the average state and local government wage rate (WS) to the firm-sector wage rate (WF), used to determine WS in Eq. 46.

PSI13.name: PSI13
PSI13.description: Exogenous productivity parameter: real gross product of the federal plus state-and-local sectors per total government employee-hour, used to add government real output to real GDP (equation 83); in our base it is computed as (PROG+PROS)/(250*(JGH+JSH+JMH)).

PSI14.name: PSI14
PSI14.description: Exogenous ratio of the housing-stock market price PKH to the domestic price deflator PD, used to set PKH in Eq. 55.

PSI15.name: PSI15
PSI15.description: Exogenous ratio of federal net interest payments to the rest of the world (INTGR) to total federal net interest payments (INTG); used to split federal interest paid abroad (equation 56).

SIG.name: SIG
SIG.description: Total employer and employee social insurance (payroll) contributions received by the federal government, in billions of dollars (defined by Eq. 103).

SIGG.name: SIGG
SIGG.description: Employer social insurance (payroll) contributions paid by the federal government as an employer to the federal government, in billions of dollars (exogenous).

SIHG.name: SIHG
SIHG.description: Employee social insurance (payroll) contributions paid by households to the federal government, in billions of dollars (defined by Eq. 53).

SIS.name: SIS
SIS.description: Total employer and employee social insurance (payroll) contributions received by state and local governments, in billions of dollars (defined by Eq. 109).

SISS.name: SISS
SISS.description: Employer social insurance (payroll) contributions paid by state and local governments as employers to state and local governments, in billions of dollars (exogenous).

SR.name: SR
SR.description: Net financial saving of the foreign sector (rest of the world), in billions of dollars (defined by Eq. 74).

SRZ.name: SRZ
SRZ.description: The approximate NIPA personal saving rate of households, expressed as a rate (defined by Eq. 116).

TRSH.name: TRSH
TRSH.description: Nominal transfer payments from state and local governments to households, excluding unemployment insurance benefits, B$.

TRSHQ.name: TRSHQ
TRSHQ.description: Real (inflation-adjusted) transfer payments from state and local governments to households, excluding unemployment insurance benefits, B2017$.

TTRRF.name: TTRRF
TTRRF.description: Nominal transfer payments and taxes from the rest of the world (foreign sector) to the firm sector, B$.

U.name: U
U.description: Number of people unemployed, in millions of persons.

UB.name: UB
UB.description: Nominal unemployment insurance benefits paid, B$.

USOTHER.name: USOTHER
USOTHER.description: Net receipts of factor income from the rest of the world excluding net interest, net dividends, and foreign earnings retained abroad, nominal B$.

USROW.name: USROW
USROW.description: Net receipts of factor income from the rest of the world (US factor income from abroad minus payments to foreigners), nominal B$.

V.name: V
V.description: Real (inflation-adjusted) stock of inventories held by the firm sector, B2017$; defined by the inventory-accounting identity (change in stock = inventory investment).
V.construction: Def., Eq. 117. Base Period=1996.4, Value=1781.1, Table 5.8.6A

D3G.name: D3G
D3G.description: Federal government indirect business (sales/excise) tax rate levied on consumer purchases; defined by the indirect-tax identity in Eq. 51.

D3S.name: D3S
D3S.description: State and local government indirect business (sales/excise) tax rate levied on consumer purchases; defined by the indirect-tax identity in Eq. 52.

GAP.name: GAP
GAP.description: Proportional gap between potential and actual output, (YS-Y)/YS; positive means actual output is below potential. (Drop unsupported 'used in price/policy' claim.)

IBTS.name: IBTS
IBTS.short_name: State and Local Indirect Business Taxes
IBTS.description: Indirect business taxes collected by state & local governments (s), B$ (A.7: RECTXS+RECRRS). ('Sales/excise-type' is too narrow.)

INTGZ.name: INTGZ
INTGZ.description: Net interest payments of the federal government divided by federal net financial liabilities (INTG/AAG), the implied effective interest rate on federal debt estimated in equation 29.

LEXZ.name: LEXZ
LEXZ.description: Natural log of real US exports (B2017$) divided by noninstitutional population (16+, millions), i.e. log real exports per capita, used as an estimation regressor.

LHF.name: LHF
LHF.description: Natural log of HF, the average number of hours paid per job in the firm sector (hours per quarter), used as an estimation regressor.

LHF1.name: LHF1
LHF1.short_name: Log Growth of Hours per Job
LHF1.description: Log quarterly change in HF (firm-sector average hours paid per job): LOG(HF/HF(-1)); the dependent variable in the hours-demand equation (FAIR eq. 14).

LHFL1A.name: LHFL1A
LHFL1A.description: Lagged log ratio of actual to potential firm-sector hours per job, LOG(HF(-1)/HFS(-1)); an error-correction term in the hours-demand equation (FAIR eq. 14).

LHO.name: LHO
LHO.description: Natural log of HO, the average overtime hours paid per job in the firm sector (hours per quarter); the dependent variable in the overtime-hours equation (FAIR eq. 15).

LIHHZ.name: LIHHZ
LIHHZ.short_name: Log Real Housing Investment per Person
LIHHZ.description: Natural log of household residential investment (B2017$) per capita, LOG(IHH/POP); the dependent variable in the residential-investment equation (FAIR eq. 4).

LIMZ.name: LIMZ
LIMZ.description: Natural log of real US imports (B2017$) per capita, LOG(IM/POP); the dependent variable in the import-demand equation (FAIR eq. 27).

LJF1.name: LJF1
LJF1.description: Log quarterly change in the number of firm-sector jobs (millions), LOG(JF/JF(-1)); the dependent variable in the employment-demand equation (FAIR eq. 13).

LJHGSZ.name: LJHGSZ
LJHGSZ.description: Natural log of total government-sector worker-hours per capita, LOG((JG*HG + JM*HM + JS*HS)/POP), combining federal civilian, military, and state-and-local jobs times their hours.

LKDZ.name: LKDZ
LKDZ.short_name: Log Durable Goods Stock per Person
LKDZ.description: Natural log of the real stock of consumer durable goods (B2017$) per capita, LOG(KD/POP), used as an estimation regressor.

LKHZ.name: LKHZ
LKHZ.description: Natural log of the household sector's real stock of housing (B2017$) per capita, LOG(KH/POP), used as an estimation regressor.

LKK.name: LKK
LKK.description: Natural log of KK, the firm sector's real stock of capital (B2017$), used as an estimation regressor.

LKK1.name: LKK1
LKK1.description: Log quarterly change in the firm sector's real capital stock, LKK - LKK(-1); the dependent variable in the fixed-investment equation (FAIR eq. 12).

LL1Z.name: LL1Z
LL1Z.description: Natural log of the labor force participation rate of men 25-54, LOG(L1/POP1); the dependent variable in the prime-age-men labor-force equation (FAIR eq. 5).

LL2Z.name: LL2Z
LL2Z.description: Natural log of the labor force participation rate of women 25-54, LOG(L2/POP2); the dependent variable in the prime-age-women labor-force equation (FAIR eq. 6).

LL3Z.name: LL3Z
LL3Z.description: Natural log of the labor force participation rate of all others aged 16+, LOG(L3/POP3); the dependent variable in the residual-group labor-force equation (FAIR eq. 7).

LLMZ.name: LLMZ
LLMZ.description: Natural log of the number of moonlighters per capita, LOG(LM/POP), where moonlighters is the gap between total jobs and total employed persons; the dependent variable in FAIR eq. 8.

LMFL1Q.name: LMFL1Q
LMFL1Q.description: Lagged natural log of real firm-sector money balances, LOG(MF(-1)/PF), where MF is firm demand deposits and currency deflated by the nonfarm price deflator PF; a first-stage estimation regressor.

LMFZ.name: LMFZ
LMFZ.description: Natural log of real firm-sector money balances, LOG(MF/PF), where MF is firm demand deposits and currency deflated by the nonfarm price deflator; the dependent variable in the firm money-demand equation (FAIR eq. 17).

LMZ.name: LMZ
LMZ.description: Number of moonlighters per capita, LM/POP, where moonlighters is the gap between total jobs and total employed persons; the per-capita series logged to form LLMZ in FAIR eq. 8.

LPF.name: LPF
LPF.description: Natural log of PF, the price deflator for nonfarm sales (the model's core price level); the dependent variable in the firm price-setting equation (FAIR eq. 10).

LPFZ.name: LPFZ
LPFZ.description: Quasi-differenced log nonfarm price deflator, LPF - DELTA1*LPF(-1) (DELTA1 = BETA1/(1-BETA2)); a transformed price regressor in the nominal-wage equation (FAIR eq. 16).

LPFZPIM.name: LPFZPIM
LPFZPIM.description: Natural log of the ratio of the nonfarm price deflator to the import price deflator, LOG(PF/PIM); a relative-price regressor in the import-demand equation (FAIR eq. 27).

LPH.name: LPH
LPH.description: Natural log of PH, the household consumption price deflator (services + nondurables + durables + residential investment, including indirect business taxes), used as an estimation regressor.

LPIEFAZ.name: LPIEFAZ
LPIEFAZ.description: Natural log of after-tax firm profits FLOORED AT 4, divided by prior-quarter dividends: LOG(PIEFAMM/DF(-1)) where PIEFAMM=max(PIEF-TFG-TFS-TFR,4). (Floor is 4, not near zero.)

LPIM.name: LPIM
LPIM.description: Natural log of PIM, the price deflator for U.S. imports, used as a cost-push regressor in the firm price equation.

LPIMZ.name: LPIMZ
LPIMZ.description: Natural log of the ratio of the import price deflator to the domestic nonfarm price deflator (PIM/PF), an estimation regressor capturing the relative cost of imports.

LPOP.name: LPOP
LPOP.description: Natural log of POP = total noninstitutional population 16+ (millions); POP = CPOP + AFT, so it INCLUDES armed forces (not 'civilian').

LTOTAL.name: LTOTAL
LTOTAL.description: Total model labor force L1+L2+L3 (millions); the L-groups include armed-forces components (L1=CL1+AF1, etc.), so not 'civilian labor force'.

LTRGSZ.name: LTRGSZ
LTRGSZ.description: Natural log of real per-capita government and state/local transfer payments to households (federal plus S&L transfers divided by population and the household price level), used as a consumption-equation regressor.

LU.name: LU
LU.description: Natural log of the number of unemployed persons (in millions, floored at 1 million to keep the log defined), used as an estimation regressor.

LUB.name: LUB
LUB.description: Natural log of UB (unemployment insurance benefits, B$); the DEPENDENT variable of equation 28 (LHS UB=EXP(LUB)), not a regressor.

LV.name: LV
LV.description: Natural log of V, the real stock of nonfarm business inventories (our 2017-dollar vintage), used as an estimation regressor.

LVZ.name: LVZ
LVZ.description: Natural log of the ratio of the real inventory stock to total real sales (V/X), used as a regressor in the inventory-investment equation.

LWAZPH.name: LWAZPH
LWAZPH.description: Natural log of the real after-tax wage rate (after-tax hourly compensation WA divided by the household price level PH), used as a labor-supply regressor.

LWF.name: LWF
LWF.description: Natural log of WF, the average hourly earnings (excluding overtime) of workers in the firm sector, used as a regressor in the wage equation.

LWFD5.name: LWFD5
LWFD5.short_name: Log Unit Labor Cost (Incl. Payroll Tax)
LWFD5.description: Natural log of the firm wage rate grossed up by the employer social-security tax rate and divided by labor productivity, i.e. log effective unit labor cost, used as the cost-push driver in the firm price equation.

LWFQ.name: LWFQ
LWFQ.description: Natural log of the firm wage rate divided by labor productivity (log WF minus log LAM), i.e. log unit labor cost excluding payroll taxes, used in the wage equation.

LWFQZ.name: LWFQZ
LWFQZ.description: The wage-equation dependent variable: log productivity-adjusted wage minus a coefficient times the lagged log nonfarm price level, imposing the model's long-run real-wage restriction in the firm wage equation.

LWFQZPF.name: LWFQZPF
LWFQZPF.description: Natural log of the productivity-adjusted firm wage deflated by the nonfarm price level (log WF minus log LAM minus log PF), an estimation regressor.

LWFZPF.name: LWFZPF
LWFZPF.description: Natural log of the firm wage rate deflated by the nonfarm price level (log WF minus log PF), an estimation regressor.

LX.name: LX
LX.description: Natural log of X, total real sales of the firm sector (our 2017-dollar vintage), used as an estimation regressor.

LXMFA.name: LXMFA
LXMFA.description: Natural log of nonfarm total sales (total sales X minus farm gross product FA, our 2017-dollar vintage), used as an estimation regressor.

LXMFAZ.name: LXMFAZ
LXMFAZ.description: Natural log of real per-capita nonfarm sales (total sales minus farm output, divided by population), used as an estimation regressor.

LY.name: LY
LY.description: Natural log of Y (total real production, B2017$); the DEPENDENT variable of the production equation (Eq. 11), not a regressor.

LY1.name: LY1
LY1.description: Quarterly log growth rate of total real production (log of current production divided by prior-quarter production), used as an estimation regressor.

LYDZ.name: LYDZ
LYDZ.description: Natural log of real per-capita household disposable income (nominal disposable income divided by population and the household price level), a key consumption-equation regressor.

POPP.name: POPP
POPP.description: Total noninstitutional population aged 16 and over, in millions, built as the sum of the three age/sex population groups (men 25-54, women 25-54, and all others 16+).

RMLMRSL2.name: RMLMRSL2
RMLMRSL2.description: Constructed interest-rate spread used as a regressor in the mortgage-rate equation: the mortgage rate lagged one quarter minus the three-month Treasury bill rate lagged two quarters, in percentage points.

RMMRSL2.name: RMMRSL2
RMMRSL2.description: Constructed spread that is the dependent variable of the mortgage-rate equation: the current mortgage rate minus the three-month Treasury bill rate lagged two quarters, in percentage points.

RQG.name: RQG
RQG.description: Weighted average of the three-month Treasury bill rate and 0.75 times current and lagged AAA corporate bond rates, expressed at a quarterly rate, used to proxy the interest rate the federal government pays on its debt in the federal interest-payments equation.

RS1.name: RS1
RS1.description: Quarterly change in the three-month Treasury bill rate (current value minus prior quarter), in percentage points, used as a dynamics regressor in the Fed interest-rate rule.

RSB.name: RSB
RSB.description: Three-month Treasury bill rate net of federal and state-and-local corporate profit tax rates, in percentage points, used as the opportunity cost of holding money in the firm money-demand equation.

RSLMRSL2.name: RSLMRSL2
RSLMRSL2.description: One-quarter change in the three-month Treasury bill rate measured between two and one quarters ago (bill rate lagged one quarter minus bill rate lagged two quarters), in percentage points, used in the bond- and mortgage-rate term-structure equations.

RSMRSL2.name: RSMRSL2
RSMRSL2.description: Two-quarter change in the three-month Treasury bill rate (current value minus the value two quarters ago), in percentage points, used in the bond- and mortgage-rate term-structure equations.

SGPZGDP.name: SGPZGDP
SGPZGDP.description: Federal government NIPA deficit expressed as a fraction of nominal GDP (negative of the federal surplus divided by GDP), so positive values indicate a deficit; a dimensionless ratio.

SIHS.name: SIHS
SIHS.description: Employee social insurance (payroll) contributions paid by households to state and local governments, in billions of dollars (exogenous).

SRZGDP.name: SRZGDP
SRZGDP.description: Net financial saving of the rest of the world (foreign sector) expressed as a fraction of nominal GDP; a dimensionless ratio.

TFGS.name: TFGS
TFGS.short_name: Federal and State/Local Corporate Profit Taxes
TFGS.description: Corporate profit taxes paid by firms to federal + state/local governments, TFG+TFS, in nominal billions of dollars (B$ — NOT B2017$; nominal flow).

TRGSZ.name: TRGSZ
TRGSZ.description: Federal+state/local transfers to households EXCLUDING unemployment insurance, deflated and per capita: (TRGH+TRSH)/(POP*PH).

UMM.name: UMM
UMM.description: Number of unemployed people in millions, floored at a minimum of 1.0 million so its logarithm is always defined; used as the unemployment regressor (in log form) in the unemployment-insurance-benefits equation.

UR1.name: UR1
UR1.description: Quarterly change in the civilian unemployment rate (current rate minus prior quarter), used as a dynamics regressor in the Fed interest-rate rule.

WAZPH.name: WAZPH
WAZPH.description: After-tax wage rate divided by the household consumption price index, giving the real (inflation-adjusted) after-tax wage.

XMFAZ.name: XMFAZ
XMFAZ.description: Total real sales excluding farm output, divided by population, giving real non-farm sales per person (in our 2017 base-year dollars).

Y1.name: Y1
Y1.description: Quarterly change in real total production (current quarter minus prior quarter), in our 2017 base-year dollars.

YDZ.name: YDZ
YDZ.description: Household disposable income deflated by the household consumption price index and divided by population, giving real disposable income per person.

YPOP.name: YPOP
YPOP.description: Real total production divided by noninstitutional population 16+ (POP1+POP2+POP3), Y/(POP1+POP2+POP3), 2017$ per person. (Denominator is 16+, not 'working-age'.)

AA1Z.name: AA1Z
AA1Z.description: Households' total net financial wealth divided by the noninstitutional population 16+, i.e. real net financial wealth per capita (2017$ vintage).

AA2Z.name: AA2Z
AA2Z.description: Households' total net housing wealth divided by the noninstitutional population 16+, i.e. real net housing wealth per capita (2017$ vintage).

AAF.name: AAF
AAF.description: Net financial liabilities (debt) of the firm sector, defined as the negative of firms' net financial assets, in nominal dollars; used as the base on which the firm interest rate INTFZ is computed.

AAG.name: AAG
AAG.description: Net financial liabilities (debt) of the federal government, defined as the negative of the government's net financial assets, in nominal dollars; used as the base on which federal interest payments are computed.

AAZ.name: AAZ
AAZ.description: Households' total net wealth (financial plus housing) divided by the noninstitutional population 16+, i.e. real net wealth per capita (2017$ vintage); its log LAAZ enters the consumption equations.

AGZGDP.name: AGZGDP
AGZGDP.description: Ratio of federal government debt (negative of its net financial assets) to annualized nominal GDP (quarterly GDP times four); a dimensionless debt-to-GDP ratio.

ASZGDP.name: ASZGDP
ASZGDP.description: Ratio of state & local government debt (negative of its net financial assets) to annualized nominal GDP (quarterly GDP times four); a dimensionless debt-to-GDP ratio.

BETA1.name: BETA1
BETA1.description: Estimated coefficient on the lagged log nonfarm price deflator log PF(-1) in price equation 10 (COEF(1,10)); combined with BETA2 to form DELTA1 = BETA1/(1-BETA2).

BETA2.name: BETA2
BETA2.description: Estimated coefficient on the unit-labor-cost term log[WF(1+D5G)/LAM] in price equation 10 (COEF(2,10)); combined with BETA1 to form DELTA1. (First pass wrongly called it the lagged-price term.)

C.name: C
C.description: The constant (intercept) term included in the estimated equations of the model; a regression specification token, not an economic time series.

CDZ.name: CDZ
CDZ.description: Real consumer expenditures on durable goods divided by the noninstitutional population 16+, i.e. per-capita real durables consumption (2017$ vintage); its log LCDZ enters the durables consumption equation.

CGZ3.name: CGZ3
CGZ3.description: Households' financial capital gains or losses summed over the current and prior two quarters, divided by the same three quarters of nominal potential output (price deflator times potential output); a scaled, smoothed capital-gains ratio.

CNZ.name: CNZ
CNZ.description: Real consumer expenditures on nondurable goods divided by the noninstitutional population 16+, i.e. per-capita real nondurables consumption (2017$ vintage); its log LCNZ enters the nondurables consumption equation.

COGS.name: COGS
COGS.description: Combined real purchases of consumption and investment goods by all governments, i.e. federal (COG) plus state & local (COS), in 2017$ (vintage); its per-capita log LCOGSZ enters the model.

CSZ.name: CSZ
CSZ.description: Real consumer expenditures on services divided by the noninstitutional population 16+, i.e. per-capita real services consumption (2017$ vintage); its log LCSZ is the LHS of the services consumption equation.

D1.name: D1
D1.description: Temporary 0/1 sub-period dummy REUSED in the estimation script (different breakpoints each time) to build time-varying constants such as cnst2cs/cnst2l2/cnst2kk; not a single fixed-window economic series.

D2.name: D2
D2.description: Temporary 0/1 middle-subperiod dummy reused with different windows to build time-varying constants; not a single fixed-window series.

D3.name: D3
D3.description: Temporary 0/1 final-subperiod dummy reused with different windows to build time-varying constants; not a single fixed-window series.

DELTA1.name: DELTA1
DELTA1.description: Derived coefficient BETA1/(1-BETA2) used in the price/wage transforms LWFQZ = LWFQ - DELTA1*LPF(-1) and LPFZ = LPF - DELTA1*LPF(-1).

EXKK.name: EXKK
EXKK.description: Firm capital held above the required amount, EXKK = KK - KKMIN; the investment equation uses the lagged log ratio log(KK/KKMIN), NOT log(EXKK).

EXL.name: EXL
EXL.description: Firm jobs above required jobs, EXL = JF - JHMIN/HFS; the jobs/hours equations use the log ratio log[JF/(JHMIN/HFS)], NOT log(EXL).

EXPGZGDP.name: EXPGZGDP
EXPGZGDP.description: Ratio of federal government net expenditures to nominal GDP; a dimensionless measure of the federal fiscal stance relative to the size of the economy.

IHHZ.name: IHHZ
IHHZ.description: Households' real residential (housing) investment divided by the noninstitutional population 16+, i.e. per-capita real residential investment (2017$ vintage); its log LIHHZ is the LHS of the housing-investment equation.

IMZ.name: IMZ
IMZ.description: Real imports of goods and services divided by noninstitutional population (per-capita scaled import demand), in B2017$ per capita.

INTFZ.name: INTFZ
INTFZ.description: Net interest payments of the firm sector divided by firm net financial liabilities (INTF/AAF), an implied effective interest rate on firm-sector debt.

INTGADJ.name: INTGADJ
INTGADJ.description: Policy assumption giving the fraction of federal net interest payments removed in the adjusted-interest scenario (JGINTG = INTG - INTGADJ*INTG); 0 means no adjustment, 0.4 means a 40% shave.

INTGZGDP.name: INTGZGDP
INTGZGDP.short_name: Federal Interest As Share Of GDP
INTGZGDP.description: Net interest payments of the federal government as a share of nominal GDP (INTG/GDP).

JHGSZ.name: JHGSZ
JHGSZ.description: Total government worker-hours (federal civilian, military, and state-and-local jobs times their average hours) divided by noninstitutional population: (JG*HG+JM*HM+JS*HS)/POP.

KDZ.name: KDZ
KDZ.description: Stock of consumer durable goods divided by noninstitutional population (KD/POP), in B2017$ per capita.

KHZ.name: KHZ
KHZ.description: Stock of housing of the household sector divided by noninstitutional population (KH/POP), in B2017$ per capita.

L1Z.name: L1Z
L1Z.description: Labor force of men 25-54 divided by the noninstitutional population of men 25-54 (L1/POP1), i.e. the participation rate for that group.

L2Z.name: L2Z
L2Z.description: Labor force of women 25-54 divided by the noninstitutional population of women 25-54 (L2/POP2), i.e. the participation rate for that group.

L3Z.name: L3Z
L3Z.description: Labor force of all others 16+ divided by the noninstitutional population of all others 16+ (L3/POP3), i.e. the participation rate for that group.

LAAZ.name: LAAZ
LAAZ.description: Natural log of household total net wealth per capita, log(AA/POP), used as an explanatory variable in the consumption and labor-force equations.

LCDZ.name: LCDZ
LCDZ.description: Natural log of real consumer durable-goods expenditure per capita, log(CD/POP); the dependent variable of the durables consumption equation (eq 3).

LCNZ.name: LCNZ
LCNZ.description: Natural log of real consumer nondurable-goods expenditure per capita, log(CN/POP); the dependent variable of the nondurables consumption equation (eq 2).

LCOGSZ.name: LCOGSZ
LCOGSZ.short_name: Log Govt Goods Purchases Per Capita
LCOGSZ.description: Natural log of total government real purchases of consumption and investment goods per capita, log((COG+COS)/POP), used as a first-stage instrument in estimation.

LCSZ.name: LCSZ
LCSZ.description: Natural log of real consumer services expenditure per capita, log(CS/POP); the dependent variable of the services consumption equation (eq 1).

LCURL1Q.name: LCURL1Q
LCURL1Q.description: Natural log of lagged currency per lagged population deflated by the CURRENT nonfarm price deflator: LOG(CUR(-1)/(POP(-1)*PF)). (Not PF(-1).)
LCURL1Q.units: log of real B$ per capita

LCURZ.name: LCURZ
LCURZ.description: Natural log of real per-capita currency holdings, log(CUR/(POP*PF)); the dependent variable of the currency-demand equation (eq 26).
LCURZ.units: log of real B$ per capita

LDF.name: LDF
LDF.description: Natural log of net dividends paid by the firm sector, log(DF), a transform of the dividend variable used in the dividend equation (eq 18).

LDF1.name: LDF1
LDF1.description: Natural log of the quarterly growth factor of firm dividends, log(DF/DF(-1)); the dependent variable of the dividend equation (eq 18).

LEX.name: LEX
LEX.description: Natural log of real exports of goods and services, log(EX), in B2017$.

LEXKK.name: LEXKK
LEXKK.description: Natural log of the ratio of actual firm capital stock to the capital required to produce current output, log(KK/KKMIN); a measure of excess (idle) capital used in the investment equation (eq 12).

LEXL.name: LEXL
LEXL.description: Natural log of the ratio of actual firm jobs to the jobs required to produce current output, log(JF/(JHMIN/HFS)); a measure of excess (hoarded) labor used in the jobs and hours equations (eqs 13-14).

LYZ.name: LYZ
LYZ.description: Log of real total production per person, log(Y/POP) — output (B2017$) divided by noninstitutional population 16+ (millions), used as a scale regressor in the import demand equation.

PCGDPD4.name: PCGDPD4
PCGDPD4.description: Year-over-year inflation rate of the GDP price deflator (GDPD), measured as the percent change over the past four quarters.

PCGDPR4.name: PCGDPR4
PCGDPR4.description: Year-over-year growth rate of real GDP (GDPR, B2017$), measured as the percent change over the past four quarters.

PCM1L1A.name: PCM1L1A
PCM1L1A.description: Lagged annualized M1 money-growth term active only during the 1979:4-1982:3 monetary-targeting regime (dummy D794823 times PCM1 lagged one quarter), used as a regressor in the Fed interest-rate rule.

PCM1L1B.name: PCM1L1B
PCM1L1B.description: Lagged annualized M1 money growth times D20083 (=1 in 1952.1-2008.3, 0 otherwise), so ACTIVE THROUGH 2008:3 and zero after, used in the Fed interest-rate rule. (First pass inverted the date window.)

PCPD.name: PCPD
PCPD.description: Annualized inflation of the domestic-sales price deflator PD, 100*((PD/PD(-1))^4-1) (gross price ratio compounded, not the percent change raised to the 4th power).

PCPD4.name: PCPD4
PCPD4.description: Year-over-year inflation rate of the domestic-sales price deflator (PD), measured as the percent change over the past four quarters.

PCPD8.name: PCPD8
PCPD8.description: Two-year (eight-quarter) annualized inflation rate of the domestic-sales price deflator (PD), measured as the percent change over the past eight quarters expressed at an annual rate.

PCPF.name: PCPF
PCPF.description: Annualized inflation of the nonfarm-sales price deflator PF, 100*((PF/PF(-1))^4-1) (gross ratio compounded).

PCPF4.name: PCPF4
PCPF4.description: Year-over-year inflation rate of the nonfarm-sales price deflator (PF), measured as the percent change over the past four quarters.

PCWF.name: PCWF
PCWF.description: Annualized growth of firm average hourly earnings excluding overtime WF, 100*((WF/WF(-1))^4-1).

PCY.name: PCY
PCY.description: Annualized growth of real total production Y, 100*((Y/Y(-1))^4-1) (gross ratio compounded); keep B2017$ vintage.

PCY4.name: PCY4
PCY4.description: Year-over-year growth rate of real total production (Y, B2017$), measured as the percent change over the past four quarters.

PIEFA.name: PIEFA
PIEFA.description: Before-tax firm profits minus corporate profit taxes to federal & state/local and taxes to the rest of the world: PIEF-TFG-TFS-TFR, nominal B$. (TFR = generic taxes f->r.)

PIEFAMM.name: PIEFAMM
PIEFAMM.description: After-tax firm profits (PIEFA, B$) with a floor of 4 billion dollars applied, ensuring the value stays positive so its logarithm can be taken in the dividend-payout equation.

RB1.name: RB1
RB1.description: One-quarter change in the corporate/long-term bond rate (RB), in percentage points.

RBA.name: RBA
RBA.description: After-tax bond rate: the bond rate (RB) multiplied by one minus the federal and state/local corporate tax rates, in percentage points.

RBA4.name: RBA4
RBA4.description: Real after-tax bond rate, in percentage points: the after-tax bond rate (RBA) minus year-over-year domestic inflation (PCPD4).

RBLMRSL2.name: RBLMRSL2
RBLMRSL2.description: Term-structure regressor in the bond-rate equation: the bond rate lagged one quarter minus the three-month Treasury bill rate lagged two quarters, in percentage points.

RBMRSL2.name: RBMRSL2
RBMRSL2.description: Term-structure dependent variable in the bond-rate equation: the current bond rate minus the three-month Treasury bill rate lagged two quarters, in percentage points.

RECGZGDP.name: RECGZGDP
RECGZGDP.description: Federal government net receipts as a fraction of nominal GDP (RECG divided by GDP).

RMACDZ.name: RMACDZ
RMACDZ.description: Constructed regressor equal to the after-tax mortgage rate (RMA) scaled by 0.01 and multiplied by the time trend (T), used in a durable-goods/consumption equation.

RMALIHHZ.name: RMALIHHZ
RMALIHHZ.short_name: Lagged After-Tax Mortgage Rate x Trend
RMALIHHZ.description: Constructed regressor equal to the after-tax mortgage rate lagged one quarter (RMA), scaled by 0.002 and multiplied by the time trend (T), used in a household investment/housing equation.

RSX.name: RSX
RSX.description: Project helper series that holds a prescribed path for the three-month Treasury bill rate; in base-RS simulation runs RS is forced to equal RSX via IDENT RS=RSX so the bill-rate path matches a chosen reference run, in percentage points.

T1.name: T1
T1.description: First time-trend breakpoint, expressed as a value of FAIR's quarterly time index T (where T=1 in 1952:1), used together with T2 to build the spline trend-shift constants (CNST2CS, CNST2L2, CNST2KK) for equations whose time trend changes across sub-periods.

T2.name: T2
T2.description: Second time-trend breakpoint, expressed as a value of FAIR's quarterly time index T (where T=1 in 1952:1), used together with T1 to build the spline trend-shift constants (CNST2CS, CNST2L2, CNST2KK) for equations whose time trend changes across sub-periods.

UBGH.name: UBGH
UBGH.description: Fraction of total unemployment-insurance benefits (UB) attributed to the federal government; it scales UB in the federal government saving identity, with the remainder (UBSH = 1 - UBGH) assigned to state-and-local governments; default value 0.5.

UBSH.name: UBSH
UBSH.description: Fraction of total unemployment-insurance benefits (UB) attributed to state-and-local governments, defined as 1 minus the federal share (UBSH = 1 - UBGH); it scales UB in the state-and-local government saving identity; default value 0.5.
